notes.title: [Beta] Eulerian graph generation available
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today is available, in beta version and to test, the generation of Eulerian Graphs!

To access it, go to the Eulerian graphs puzzle set and access it with the button at the top right.
You will be asked for the number of vertices you want (between 10 and 80 for performance and display reasons on the graphic scene).
After several steps of random generation, modification and verification, your graph, which respects the properties of Eulerian walks, is available for its resolution.

Note that, even with the same number of vertices, the number of edges can vary a lot.

It could be, especially with a small number of vertices, that the process could not generate it. In this case, just try again :)

Also, in the normal game, access to the previous levels is now possible.

Have fun, and feel free to give feedback.
